inputs.original_text: That so-called graduation protest in Jaipur is pure theater orchestrated from the top. A student stands up calling out administrative issues right in front of the Deputy Chief Minister. The whole thing blows up with these obviously staged reactions, and the university just sits there in total silence. That's not confusion or bravery—it's hidden elites running the institutions letting the story spread on purpose. They're using it to divide people, whip up fake outrage, and bury any real questions about who's actually controlling education and power. The official silence is no accident, it's the green light to twist the narrative and keep everyone distracted from the coordinated manipulation behind the scenes.
